alvo.nome_longo: Cruzain (cruzipain), the major cysteine protease of Trypanosoma cruzi
alvo.doenca_nota: Over 10,000 deaths a year in the Americas. Current therapy has poor efficacy in the chronic phase and serious side effects.
alvo.recorde_fonte: A published campaign docked nearly 4 million lead-like and fragment-like compounds against cruzain, which led to reversible carbamoyl imidazole inhibitors (PubMed 31765144).
alvo.estado_nota: Kept only so the laboratory has a real structure to replay. This protein was worked on before this launch and is not this project's record.

triagem._comentario: Zerado no relancamento. Volta a encher quando a primeira triagem rodar sob este projeto.

validacao._comentario: O enriquecimento e a reproducao de pose do alvo anterior sairam junto com o projeto anterior. O controle positivo de POSE fica: ele valida a pipeline, nao o alvo.

roadmap.nome: Prove the method can separate real inhibitors from lookalikes
roadmap.base: One enrichment run against a case with a published, achievable score. Until this passes, rejecting a target proves nothing about the target. It is the step this project has never run, and everything else waits on it.
About 650 dockings per attempt: measured inhibitors against property-matched decoys, with the pass mark written down first. A target that fails is published with the number that failed it.

Collection work, not compute: purchasable compounds pulled from the public catalogues so that anything found can actually be bought and tested. It spends nothing on hardware, which is why it carries no price rather than a price of zero.

Estimated from a measured rate: 414 molecules an hour on 56 rented cores at $0.18 an hour, which is $0.000435 a molecule. That rate was measured on a card that has since been released, and it is CPU docking; moving to the GPU should cut it, and that is not assumed here.

roadmap.nome: Four million molecules, the size of the largest published screen
roadmap.base: Same measured rate, four times the molecules.
Made to order, roughly three weeks. No supplier has quoted us, so this is an order of magnitude and not a price.

roadmap.nome: Enzyme assay in a real laboratory
roadmap.base: Does the compound actually block the protein? Needs a laboratory to quote it, which is a conversation rather than a web search.

roadmap.nome: Cell assay — parasite killed, human cells spared
roadmap.base: The last rung this project can reach on its own.

roadmap_total.nota: Everything from an empty screen to a result on a real laboratory bench. The computing is the cheap part: at the rate measured before this launch, four million molecules cost $1,740. It is the glassware that costs.

compute.nota: Nothing has been rented under this launch yet. Every hour paid for will be published here with its date and price.
